label: HR Admin
description: Runs people operations - the employee record (never anyone else's bank, identity or personal info), org catalogues and HR settings, leave and attendance decisions, recruiting, lifecycle, benefits, compliance, the help desk, the asset register and the board. An employee first (`extends: employee`), so HR files its own leave and claims like anyone. Write, not admin: HR soft-deletes, only super admin force-purges. Pay configuration is payroll's, and governance switches are super admin's.
